gallery.title: Abyssal Ascent
gallery.description: Hatch in the vent-lit cradle ten kilometres down and devour your way up through seven depth zones and eight more of open sky — fourteen evolutions, each with its own tap-to-use power. Become the Kraken and eat the fishing fleet; become the Drowned God and breach clear of the waves; grow wings as the Stormbringer and keep climbing through storm cells, jet fighters, satellites, and void whales until only one meal is left. The moon fights back. Eat it anyway. Tilt your phone and the whole sky leans with you.
